GB.OBS.MOVE_OFF_CHECKS.title: Pull away safely
GB.OBS.MOVE_OFF_CHECKS.fault: You moved off without leaving a safe gap.
GB.OBS.MOVE_OFF_CHECKS.why: Traffic approaches fast from behind on your right. Moving into its path forces drivers to brake.
GB.OBS.MOVE_OFF_CHECKS.tip: Check mirrors and your right blind spot before pulling away.
GB.OBS.MOVE_OFF_CHECKS.good: You waited for a clear gap before pulling away.

GB.OBS.MSM.title: Mirrors, signal, manoeuvre
GB.OBS.MSM.fault: Your manoeuvre forced another driver to brake.
GB.OBS.MSM.why: Following drivers need time to react to your speed or lane change. Sudden moves create rear-end risks.
GB.OBS.MSM.tip: Use the MSM routine before changing speed or direction.
GB.OBS.MSM.good: You signalled early and changed speed smoothly.

GB.SIG.TIMELY.title: Signal in good time
GB.SIG.TIMELY.fault: You signalled too late or left it on.
GB.SIG.TIMELY.why: Other road users need early warning of your plan. A late signal gives them no time to react.
GB.SIG.TIMELY.tip: Signal early, then cancel as soon as you finish turning.
GB.SIG.TIMELY.good: Your signals were clear and cancelled promptly.

GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.title: Keep to the left
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.fault: You drove on the wrong side of the road.
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.why: In the UK, traffic stays on the left. Driving on the right risks a head-on crash.
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.tip: Stay on the left unless overtaking or passing an obstruction.
GB.POS.KEEP_LEFT.good: You kept a steady position on the left.

GB.POS.AFTER_TURN.title: Finish turn on left
GB.POS.AFTER_TURN.fault: You ended your turn in the right lane.
GB.POS.AFTER_TURN.why: Turning into the wrong lane puts you in oncoming traffic. Always aim for the left side of the new road.
GB.POS.AFTER_TURN.tip: Look into the left lane of the side road as you turn.
GB.POS.AFTER_TURN.good: You turned cleanly into the left lane.

GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.title: Speed limit exceeded
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.fault: You drove at {speedMph} mph in a {limitMph} mph limit.
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.why: Higher speeds increase your stopping distance and crash harm. You must never exceed the posted speed limit.
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.tip: Check your speedometer and watch for new limit signs.
GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.good: You kept within the {limitMph} mph speed limit.

GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.title: Two-second following gap
GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.why: Tailgating leaves too little time to stop if traffic slows. Keep at least a two-second gap on faster roads.
GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.tip: Pick a roadside marker and count two seconds behind the car ahead.
GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.good: You maintained a safe following gap.

GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.title: Give way at junction
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.fault: You pulled out and forced main-road traffic to slow down.
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.why: You must give way to traffic on the main road. Entering a tight gap puts everyone at risk.
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.tip: Wait until both lanes are clear before emerging.
GB.JCT.GIVE_WAY.good: You judged the gap well and gave way safely.

GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.title: Give way to pedestrians
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.fault: You did not give way to a waiting pedestrian.
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.why: Under H2, people crossing or waiting at a junction have priority. Turning across them puts them in danger.
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.tip: Slow down before turning and let pedestrians cross the side road.
GB.JCT.H2_PEDESTRIANS.good: You waited patiently for pedestrians to cross.

GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.title: Wait for safe gap
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.fault: You turned right across oncoming traffic.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.why: Oncoming vehicles have priority when you turn across their lane. Misjudging their speed can cause a side impact.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.tip: Wait until oncoming traffic is far enough away to turn safely.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_GAP.good: You waited for a safe gap before turning right.

GB.TL.RED.title: Stop on red
GB.TL.RED.fault: You crossed the stop line on red.
GB.TL.RED.why: A red light means other traffic or pedestrians have a green signal. You must stop behind the white stop line.
GB.TL.RED.tip: Scan traffic lights early so you can brake smoothly.
GB.TL.RED.good: You stopped cleanly behind the white line on red.

GB.TL.AMBER.title: Stop on amber
GB.TL.AMBER.fault: You drove through amber when you could stop.
GB.TL.AMBER.why: Amber means stop unless you are too close to stop safely. You must not treat amber as a late green.
GB.TL.AMBER.tip: Ease off the throttle when a light has been green for a while.
GB.TL.AMBER.good: You stopped safely when the light turned amber.

GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.title: Give way to right
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.fault: You entered the roundabout ahead of right-side traffic.
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.why: Traffic already on the roundabout approaches from your right. You must give way at the broken lines.
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.tip: Look right early and wait for a clear gap before joining.
GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.good: You gave way to circulating traffic from the right.

GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.title: Choose roundabout lane
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.fault: You approached the roundabout in the wrong lane.
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.why: The wrong lane forces late lane changes on the roundabout. Follow lane arrows and choose left for left or right for right.
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.tip: Check lane arrows early as you approach the roundabout.
GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.good: You picked the right lane before reaching the roundabout.

GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.title: Signal before roundabout
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.fault: Your roundabout approach signal was missing or wrong.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.why: Other drivers rely on your signal to read your exit. Signal left for left exits and right for exits past straight ahead.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.tip: Signal clearly before the give-way line when turning.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.good: Your approach signal matched your chosen exit.

GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.title: Signal to leave roundabout
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.fault: You did not signal left before exiting.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.why: Waiting drivers need to know you are leaving the roundabout. Without a left signal, traffic behind and ahead is delayed.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.tip: Signal left right after you pass the exit before yours.
GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.good: You signalled left in good time before exiting.

GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.title: Circulate clockwise
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.fault: You travelled anti-clockwise around the roundabout.
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.why: In the UK, all roundabouts flow clockwise around the island. You must never turn right directly into oncoming roundabout traffic.
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.tip: Keep the central island on your right at every roundabout.
GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.good: You circulated clockwise around the roundabout.

GB.XNG.ZEBRA.title: Stop at zebra crossing
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.fault: You failed to give way at the zebra crossing.
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.why: You must stop once someone steps onto a zebra crossing. Slowing for waiting people keeps everyone safe.
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.tip: Check both pavements as you approach the flashing orange beacons.
GB.XNG.ZEBRA.good: You stopped smoothly to let pedestrians cross.

GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.title: Leave room for cyclists
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.fault: You passed a cyclist with only {clearanceM} m space.
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.why: Cyclists may swerve to avoid drains or potholes. Leave at least 1.5 m up to 30 mph and more at higher speeds.
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.tip: Wait behind the cyclist if oncoming traffic prevents a wide pass.
GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.good: You gave the cyclist plenty of room when passing.

GB.SCH.CHILD_STEPS_OUT.title: Watch for hidden hazards
GB.SCH.CHILD_STEPS_OUT.fault: You were too fast past parked cars.
GB.SCH.CHILD_STEPS_OUT.why: Children can step out unseen from between parked vehicles. Lower speed gives you time to stop safely.
GB.SCH.CHILD_STEPS_OUT.tip: Slow down and scan under and between parked cars.
GB.SCH.CHILD_STEPS_OUT.good: You kept a safe speed and stopped in time.

GB.MWY.JOIN.title: Join motorway safely
GB.MWY.JOIN.fault: You joined the motorway too slowly or crossed solid lines.
GB.MWY.JOIN.why: Traffic on the main motorway moves much faster. You must give way and match its speed on the slip road.
GB.MWY.JOIN.tip: Use the full slip road to match speed and merge into a gap.
GB.MWY.JOIN.good: You matched speed and merged smoothly into lane one.

GB.MWY.RED_X.title: Obey red X signals
GB.MWY.RED_X.fault: You drove in a lane closed by a red X.
GB.MWY.RED_X.why: A red X closes the lane for stranded cars or workers ahead. You must move to an open lane or stop.
GB.MWY.RED_X.tip: Watch overhead gantries and leave closed lanes early.
GB.MWY.RED_X.good: You moved out of the closed lane promptly.

GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.title: Safe lane change
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.fault: You changed lanes into another vehicle's path.
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.why: A car can hide in your blind spot beside your rear quarter. Moving over too soon forces other drivers to brake hard.
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.tip: Check mirrors, look over your shoulder, signal, then move smoothly.
GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.good: You checked your blind spot and changed lanes smoothly.

GB.SIG.MISLEADING.title: Avoid misleading signals
GB.SIG.MISLEADING.why: A wrong or early signal can tempt side-road traffic to pull out. Make sure your signal matches your real path.
GB.SIG.MISLEADING.tip: Only signal after passing side roads you are not taking.
GB.SIG.MISLEADING.good: Your signals were clear and never misled anyone.

GB.POS.LANE_FOR_ROUTE.title: Follow lane arrows
GB.POS.LANE_FOR_ROUTE.fault: You took a route that broke lane arrows.
GB.POS.LANE_FOR_ROUTE.why: Lane arrows sort traffic safely through busy junctions. Late lane swaps over solid lines cause sudden conflicts.
GB.POS.LANE_FOR_ROUTE.tip: Read overhead signs and road arrows well before the junction.
GB.POS.LANE_FOR_ROUTE.good: You chose the right lane early and followed arrows.

GB.POS.DUAL_KEEP_LEFT.title: Keep left on dual carriageway
GB.POS.DUAL_KEEP_LEFT.fault: You stayed in the right lane without overtaking.
GB.POS.DUAL_KEEP_LEFT.why: On a two-lane dual carriageway, the right lane is for overtaking or turning right. Hogging it blocks faster traffic.
GB.POS.DUAL_KEEP_LEFT.tip: Move back to the left lane once your overtake is complete.
GB.POS.DUAL_KEEP_LEFT.good: You returned to the left lane after overtaking.

GB.SPD.NATIONAL_LIMIT.title: National speed limit
GB.SPD.NATIONAL_LIMIT.fault: You drove at {speedMph} mph above the {limitMph} mph national limit.
GB.SPD.NATIONAL_LIMIT.why: The national limit is 60 mph on single carriageways, or 70 mph on dual carriageways. You must stay within it.
GB.SPD.NATIONAL_LIMIT.tip: Check whether the road has a central barrier to know the limit.
GB.SPD.NATIONAL_LIMIT.good: You matched the correct national speed limit.

GB.SPD.BUILT_UP.title: Built-up speed limit
GB.SPD.BUILT_UP.fault: You exceeded the {limitMph} mph built-up limit.
GB.SPD.BUILT_UP.why: Built-up streets are 30 mph in England and Scotland, and 20 mph in Wales. You must obey the local limit.
GB.SPD.BUILT_UP.tip: Remember the 20 mph default when entering Welsh towns.
GB.SPD.BUILT_UP.good: You respected the built-up area speed limit.

GB.SPD.STREET_LIGHTING.title: Street lights mean built-up
GB.SPD.STREET_LIGHTING.fault: You missed the built-up speed limit cue.
GB.SPD.STREET_LIGHTING.why: Regular street lights with no repeater signs mean the built-up limit applies. Watch for the change when entering a town.
GB.SPD.STREET_LIGHTING.tip: Look for street lights as a cue to check your speed.
GB.SPD.STREET_LIGHTING.good: You spotted the street lights and adjusted your speed.

GB.SPD.APPROPRIATE.title: Drive to the conditions
GB.SPD.APPROPRIATE.fault: Your speed of {speedMph} mph was too fast for conditions.
GB.SPD.APPROPRIATE.why: The speed limit is a maximum, not a target. Wet roads, bends, and dark streets require extra stopping distance.
GB.SPD.APPROPRIATE.tip: Always be able to stop within the distance you can see ahead.
GB.SPD.APPROPRIATE.good: You matched your speed safely to the road conditions.

GB.SPD.PROGRESS.title: Make safe progress
GB.SPD.PROGRESS.fault: You held up traffic on a clear road.
GB.SPD.PROGRESS.why: Driving much slower than safe traffic speed frustrates drivers behind. It can cause risky overtakes.
GB.SPD.PROGRESS.tip: Keep up with safe traffic flow when the road ahead is clear.

GB.SPD.WORKS_TEMP.title: Roadworks speed limit
GB.SPD.WORKS_TEMP.fault: You drove at {speedMph} mph in a {limitMph} mph roadworks zone.
GB.SPD.WORKS_TEMP.why: Roadworks have narrow lanes and workers close to traffic. You must obey every temporary speed limit.
GB.SPD.WORKS_TEMP.tip: Slow down before entering the coned roadworks area.
GB.SPD.WORKS_TEMP.good: You kept to the temporary roadworks limit.

GB.SPD.VARIABLE.title: Obey variable speed limits
GB.SPD.VARIABLE.fault: You exceeded the {limitMph} mph gantry speed limit.
GB.SPD.VARIABLE.why: Red-circle gantry signs set legal limits to prevent queues ahead. You must slow down before passing the sign.
GB.SPD.VARIABLE.tip: Check every overhead gantry for red-circle speed changes.
GB.SPD.VARIABLE.good: You adjusted promptly to the gantry speed limit.

GB.GAP.STOPPING_TABLE.title: Know stopping distances
GB.GAP.STOPPING_TABLE.fault: Your stopping distance exceeded the clear gap.
GB.GAP.STOPPING_TABLE.why: Stopping distance grows quickly with speed. At 70 mph it takes about 96 metres to stop in dry weather.
GB.GAP.STOPPING_TABLE.tip: Leave more space as your speed rises.
GB.GAP.STOPPING_TABLE.good: You left enough room to stop smoothly.

GB.GAP.CUT_IN.title: Restore gap after cut-in
GB.GAP.CUT_IN.fault: You stayed too close after a car cut in.
GB.GAP.CUT_IN.why: When another car fills your space, your stopping margin disappears. Ease off gently to rebuild your two-second gap.
GB.GAP.CUT_IN.tip: Lift off the throttle when someone merges in front of you.
GB.GAP.CUT_IN.good: You dropped back calmly to restore your gap.

GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.title: Stop at Stop sign
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.fault: You rolled past the Stop sign line.
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.why: Stop signs sit at junctions with very poor visibility. You must bring all wheels to a full stop at the solid line.
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.tip: Stop completely at the line, then look both ways before moving.
GB.JCT.STOP_SIGN.good: You came to a complete stop at the line.

GB.JCT.H3_CYCLISTS.title: Do not cut across cyclists
GB.JCT.H3_CYCLISTS.fault: You turned across a cyclist going straight ahead.
GB.JCT.H3_CYCLISTS.why: Under H3, cyclists going ahead have priority over turning traffic. Cutting across their path causes serious collisions.
GB.JCT.H3_CYCLISTS.tip: Check your left mirror and wait for cyclists before turning left.
GB.JCT.H3_CYCLISTS.good: You let the cyclist pass before making your turn.

GB.JCT.BOX.title: Keep box junctions clear
GB.JCT.BOX.fault: You stopped inside the yellow box junction.
GB.JCT.BOX.why: Blocking a box junction traps crossing traffic when lights change. You must not enter unless your exit road is clear.
GB.JCT.BOX.tip: Wait behind the yellow grid until space opens beyond it.
GB.JCT.BOX.good: You waited until your exit was clear before entering.

GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_POSITION.title: Position for right turn
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_POSITION.fault: Your road position for turning right was poor.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_POSITION.why: Staying near the centre line lets traffic pass safely on your left. It also gives you a clearer view ahead.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_POSITION.tip: Move just left of the centre line while keeping wheels straight.
GB.JCT.TURN_FAR_POSITION.good: You positioned neatly near the centre line.

GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.title: Keep left turning left
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.fault: You swung wide or crossed an active lane.
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.why: Swinging out wide can surprise traffic beside you. Keep close to the left kerb and give way to bus or cycle lanes.
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.tip: Slow down early so you can turn tightly around the left corner.
GB.JCT.TURN_NEAR.good: You kept close to the left through the turn.

GB.JCT.EMERGE_LOOK.title: Creep and look carefully
GB.JCT.EMERGE_LOOK.fault: You emerged too fast at a blind junction.
GB.JCT.EMERGE_LOOK.why: Walls or parked cars can hide fast approaching traffic. High speed leaves no time to stop if the road is busy.
GB.JCT.EMERGE_LOOK.tip: Slow right down and creep forward until you can see clearly.
GB.JCT.EMERGE_LOOK.good: You crept forward carefully at the blind junction.

GB.TL.RED_AMBER.title: Wait for green
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.fault: You crossed the line on red and amber.
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.why: Red and amber together mean get ready, not go. You must wait behind the stop line until green appears.
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.tip: Stay stopped until the green light comes on.
GB.TL.RED_AMBER.good: You waited until the light turned green.

GB.TL.NO_TURN_ON_RED.title: No turning on red
GB.TL.NO_TURN_ON_RED.fault: You turned left on a red light.
GB.TL.NO_TURN_ON_RED.why: Unlike some countries, the UK has no turn on red. You must wait at the white line for a green light.
GB.TL.NO_TURN_ON_RED.tip: Always stop and wait on red even when turning left.
GB.TL.NO_TURN_ON_RED.good: You waited for green before turning left.

GB.TL.CLEAR_JUNCTION.title: Do not block junction
GB.TL.CLEAR_JUNCTION.fault: You entered on green and blocked the junction.
GB.TL.CLEAR_JUNCTION.why: If your exit is blocked, you will trap cross traffic when lights change. You must only enter when you can clear the junction.
GB.TL.CLEAR_JUNCTION.tip: Hold back at the green light if traffic ahead is queued.
GB.TL.CLEAR_JUNCTION.good: You kept the junction clear in heavy traffic.

GB.TL.FILTER_ARROW.title: Follow green filter arrow
GB.TL.FILTER_ARROW.fault: You went against the green filter arrow.
GB.TL.FILTER_ARROW.why: A green filter arrow only permits traffic in the arrow direction. You must wait for the main green for other routes.
GB.TL.FILTER_ARROW.tip: Check which lane and direction the green arrow points to.
GB.TL.FILTER_ARROW.good: You followed the filter arrow correctly.

GB.TL.ASL.title: Stop before cyclist box
GB.TL.ASL.fault: You stopped inside the cyclist waiting box.
GB.TL.ASL.why: The ASL box gives cyclists a safe head start at lights. On red or amber, you must stop at the first white line.
GB.TL.ASL.tip: Stop behind the first line whenever you see a bike box.
GB.TL.ASL.good: You left the ASL box clear for cyclists.

GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.title: Stay in roundabout lane
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.fault: You drifted across lanes on the roundabout.
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.why: Crossing lanes mid-roundabout surprises cars beside you. Follow spiral road markings all the way to your exit.
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.tip: Keep inside your marked lane until you exit.
GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.good: You held your lane cleanly around the roundabout.

GB.RBT.CYCLISTS.title: Give cyclists roundabout space
GB.RBT.CYCLISTS.fault: You cut across a cyclist on the roundabout.
GB.RBT.CYCLISTS.why: Cyclists may stay in the left lane even when turning right. Give them space and never cut across them at exits.
GB.RBT.CYCLISTS.tip: Check your left side for cyclists before leaving a roundabout.
GB.RBT.CYCLISTS.good: You gave the cyclist plenty of room on the roundabout.

GB.RBT.MINI.title: Go around mini-roundabout
GB.RBT.MINI.fault: You drove straight over the mini-roundabout circle.
GB.RBT.MINI.why: You must drive around the painted white circle, not over it. Cutting across confuses other drivers and risks collisions.
GB.RBT.MINI.tip: Steer around the white disc and avoid U-turns.
GB.RBT.MINI.good: You steered cleanly around the mini-roundabout.

GB.RBT.DOUBLE_MINI.title: Treat each mini separately
GB.RBT.DOUBLE_MINI.fault: You failed to give way at the second mini-roundabout.
GB.RBT.DOUBLE_MINI.why: Double mini-roundabouts work as two separate junctions. Give way to traffic from the right at each white circle.
GB.RBT.DOUBLE_MINI.tip: Reset your scan and look right again at the second circle.

GB.XNG.PELICAN_AMBER.title: Yield on flashing amber
GB.XNG.PELICAN_AMBER.fault: You entered a pelican crossing with someone still on it.
GB.XNG.PELICAN_AMBER.why: Flashing amber means you must give way to anyone still crossing. Drive on only once the crossing is completely clear.
GB.XNG.PELICAN_AMBER.tip: Wait until the last pedestrian reaches the kerb on flashing amber.
GB.XNG.PELICAN_AMBER.good: You waited until the pelican crossing was clear.

GB.XNG.LIGHT_CROSSINGS.title: Obey crossing signals
GB.XNG.LIGHT_CROSSINGS.fault: You drove through a red crossing signal.
GB.XNG.LIGHT_CROSSINGS.why: Puffin and toucan crossings use standard traffic lights with no flashing amber. You must stop on red and wait for green.
GB.XNG.LIGHT_CROSSINGS.tip: Stop behind the white line whenever crossing lights turn red.
GB.XNG.LIGHT_CROSSINGS.good: You obeyed the crossing lights cleanly.

GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.title: No overtaking on zig-zags
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.fault: You overtook inside the crossing zig-zag lines.
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.why: A stopped car near a crossing hides people stepping out. You must not overtake the leading vehicle in the zig-zag zone.
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.tip: Stay behind traffic on white zig-zag lines.
GB.XNG.ZIGZAG_OVERTAKE.good: You held back safely through the zig-zag zone.

GB.XNG.KEEP_CLEAR.title: Keep crossings clear
GB.XNG.KEEP_CLEAR.fault: You stopped on the pedestrian crossing in a queue.
GB.XNG.KEEP_CLEAR.why: Stopping on a crossing blocks pedestrians and hides them from view. Wait before the crossing until space opens ahead.
GB.XNG.KEEP_CLEAR.tip: Check that traffic ahead has room before rolling onto a crossing.
GB.XNG.KEEP_CLEAR.good: You kept the crossing clear in queuing traffic.

GB.XNG.SCHOOL_PATROL.title: Stop for school patrol
GB.XNG.SCHOOL_PATROL.fault: You drove past a raised school patrol sign.
GB.XNG.SCHOOL_PATROL.why: School crossing patrols protect children crossing busy roads. You must stop whenever they show the stop sign.
GB.XNG.SCHOOL_PATROL.tip: Watch for school patrols in bright coats near schools.
GB.XNG.SCHOOL_PATROL.good: You stopped promptly for the school crossing patrol.

GB.VRU.HIERARCHY.title: Protect vulnerable road users
GB.VRU.HIERARCHY.fault: You put a more vulnerable road user at risk.
GB.VRU.HIERARCHY.why: Under H1, drivers carry greater responsibility than pedestrians and cyclists. Always give extra space and time to people outside cars.
GB.VRU.HIERARCHY.tip: Give way generously to pedestrians, cyclists, and horse riders.
GB.VRU.HIERARCHY.good: You showed great care for vulnerable road users.

GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_SOLID.title: Solid-line cycle lane
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_SOLID.fault: You drove inside a solid-line cycle lane.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_SOLID.why: A solid white line marks a protected cycle lane during its hours. You must not drive or park inside it.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_SOLID.tip: Stay to the right of solid white cycle lane lines.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_SOLID.good: You kept clear of the solid-line cycle lane.

GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_BROKEN.title: Avoid broken cycle lane
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_BROKEN.fault: You entered a broken-line cycle lane unnecessarily.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_BROKEN.why: Broken-line cycle lanes keep cyclists safe in busy traffic. Do not drive in them unless it is unavoidable.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_BROKEN.tip: Keep out of broken cycle lanes unless passing an obstruction.
GB.VRU.CYCLE_LANE_BROKEN.good: You left the cycle lane clear for riders.

GB.VRU.CHILDREN.title: Expect children near roads
GB.VRU.CHILDREN.fault: You drove too fast near children or pedestrians.
GB.VRU.CHILDREN.why: Children can act suddenly and misjudge traffic speed. Hitting someone at 20 mph is far less fatal than at 30 mph.
GB.VRU.CHILDREN.tip: Slow down and watch closely near parks, shops, and schools.
GB.VRU.CHILDREN.good: You slowed down and watched carefully for children.

GB.BUS.LANE_HOURS.title: Respect bus lane hours
GB.BUS.LANE_HOURS.fault: You drove in an active bus lane.
GB.BUS.LANE_HOURS.why: Bus lanes keep public transport moving during peak times. Check the blue sign for operating hours before entering.
GB.BUS.LANE_HOURS.tip: Read the time plate on the blue bus lane sign.
GB.BUS.LANE_HOURS.good: You stayed out of the bus lane during active hours.

GB.SCH.SLOW.title: Slow near schools
GB.SCH.SLOW.fault: You drove too fast past a flashing school sign.
GB.SCH.SLOW.why: Flashing amber lights under a school sign mean children may be crossing. Drive very slowly and prepare to stop.
GB.SCH.SLOW.tip: Drop to 20 mph or less when school warning lights flash.
GB.SCH.SLOW.good: You slowed down safely past the school.

GB.SCH.KEEP_CLEAR.title: Keep school entrance clear
GB.SCH.KEEP_CLEAR.fault: You stopped on school keep-clear zig-zags.
GB.SCH.KEEP_CLEAR.why: Parked cars block sightlines for children crossing outside schools. You must not stop on yellow zig-zags when signs prohibit it.
GB.SCH.KEEP_CLEAR.tip: Never stop or drop off on yellow school zig-zags.
GB.SCH.KEEP_CLEAR.good: You kept the school entrance zig-zags clear.

GB.EMG.LET_PASS.title: Make way safely
GB.EMG.LET_PASS.fault: You blocked an emergency vehicle or broke a rule.
GB.EMG.LET_PASS.why: Emergency vehicles need room to pass quickly. However, never run red lights or mount kerbs to clear the way.
GB.EMG.LET_PASS.tip: Pull over safely when legal without breaking other traffic rules.
GB.EMG.LET_PASS.good: You made room safely and legally for the ambulance.

GB.OVT.UNSAFE_PLACE.title: Do not overtake blind
GB.OVT.UNSAFE_PLACE.fault: You overtook where visibility was too short.
GB.OVT.UNSAFE_PLACE.why: Bends, hill brows, and junctions hide oncoming traffic. Starting a pass blind risks a severe head-on collision.
GB.OVT.UNSAFE_PLACE.tip: Wait for a long, clear straight with no junctions ahead.
GB.OVT.UNSAFE_PLACE.good: You held back until the road ahead was clear.

GB.OVT.DOUBLE_WHITE.title: Obey solid double white lines
GB.OVT.DOUBLE_WHITE.fault: You crossed a solid white centre line.
GB.OVT.DOUBLE_WHITE.why: Solid lines mark stretches where overtaking is unsafe. You must not cross unless turning off or passing traffic at 10 mph or less.
GB.OVT.DOUBLE_WHITE.tip: Wait until the line nearest you becomes broken before overtaking.
GB.OVT.DOUBLE_WHITE.good: You stayed on your side of the solid white line.

GB.OVT.INTO_LANE.title: No overtaking into bus lanes
GB.OVT.INTO_LANE.fault: You overtook by entering an active bus or cycle lane.
GB.OVT.INTO_LANE.why: Bus and cycle lanes are reserved for specific road users. You must not enter them to overtake slower traffic.
GB.OVT.INTO_LANE.tip: Wait behind until it is safe to pass on the right.
GB.OVT.INTO_LANE.good: You stayed out of reserved lanes while overtaking.

GB.MWY.LEARNERS.title: Motorway rules for learners
GB.MWY.LEARNERS.fault: Learners need an ADI on motorways.
GB.MWY.LEARNERS.why: High-speed motorway driving requires experience. Learner drivers must only drive on motorways with an ADI in a dual-control car.
GB.MWY.LEARNERS.tip: Book motorway lessons with an ADI before driving there solo.
GB.MWY.LEARNERS.good: You followed the learner motorway requirement.

GB.MWY.KEEP_LEFT.title: Keep left on motorways
GB.MWY.KEEP_LEFT.fault: You stayed in an outer motorway lane needlessly.
GB.MWY.KEEP_LEFT.why: Middle-lane hogging forces traffic to change lanes twice to pass. Stay in the left lane unless you are overtaking.
GB.MWY.KEEP_LEFT.tip: Move back left whenever there is a clear gap in lane one.
GB.MWY.KEEP_LEFT.good: You returned promptly to the left motorway lane.

GB.MWY.OVERTAKE_RIGHT.title: Overtake on the right
GB.MWY.OVERTAKE_RIGHT.fault: You overtook on the left on a motorway.
GB.MWY.OVERTAKE_RIGHT.why: Drivers expect faster traffic to pass on their right. Passing on the left creates blind-spot surprises.
GB.MWY.OVERTAKE_RIGHT.tip: Always overtake on the right and move back left afterwards.
GB.MWY.OVERTAKE_RIGHT.good: You overtook cleanly on the right.

GB.MWY.NO_UNDERTAKE.title: Do not undertake
GB.MWY.NO_UNDERTAKE.fault: You passed slower traffic on the left.
GB.MWY.NO_UNDERTAKE.why: Undertaking at speed is dangerous when drivers move back left. Only pass on the left in slow-moving queues.
GB.MWY.NO_UNDERTAKE.tip: Wait for the car ahead to move left or pass on the right.

GB.MWY.AMBER_FLASH.title: Slow for flashing amber
GB.MWY.AMBER_FLASH.fault: You ignored flashing amber motorway signals.
GB.MWY.AMBER_FLASH.why: Flashing amber signals warn of a hazard, queue, or incident ahead. Slow down until you pass a clear signal or national limit sign.
GB.MWY.AMBER_FLASH.tip: Ease off the speed when gantry amber lights flash.
GB.MWY.AMBER_FLASH.good: You slowed down promptly for the warning lights.

GB.MWY.HARD_SHOULDER.title: Keep off hard shoulder
GB.MWY.HARD_SHOULDER.fault: You drove on an inactive hard shoulder.
GB.MWY.HARD_SHOULDER.why: The hard shoulder is for breakdowns and emergency vehicles. You must not use it unless a gantry shows a speed limit above it.
GB.MWY.HARD_SHOULDER.tip: Only use the hard shoulder when overhead signs open it.
GB.MWY.HARD_SHOULDER.good: You stayed off the closed hard shoulder.

GB.MWY.EMERGENCY_AREA.title: Emergency areas for emergencies
GB.MWY.EMERGENCY_AREA.fault: You stopped in an emergency area without an emergency.
GB.MWY.EMERGENCY_AREA.why: Orange emergency areas are lifelines for broken-down vehicles. You must not stop in one for breaks, calls, or directions.
GB.MWY.EMERGENCY_AREA.tip: Use motorway services for rest stops, never emergency areas.
GB.MWY.EMERGENCY_AREA.good: You left the emergency area clear for emergencies.

GB.MWY.NO_STOP.title: Never stop in live lane
GB.MWY.NO_STOP.fault: You stopped in a live motorway lane.
GB.MWY.NO_STOP.why: Traffic approaches at 70 mph and cannot stop quickly. You must never stop in a motorway lane except in an emergency.
GB.MWY.NO_STOP.tip: Keep moving to the next exit or services if unsure of your route.
GB.MWY.NO_STOP.good: You kept traffic flowing safely on the motorway.

GB.MWY.NO_REVERSE.title: Never reverse on motorways
GB.MWY.NO_REVERSE.fault: You reversed or drove against motorway traffic.
GB.MWY.NO_REVERSE.why: Reversing or turning around on a motorway causes catastrophic crashes. You must drive on to the next junction if you miss your exit.
GB.MWY.NO_REVERSE.tip: If you miss an exit, stay calm and take the next one.
GB.MWY.NO_REVERSE.good: You continued safely to the next exit.

GB.MWY.LEAVE.title: Leave motorway safely
GB.MWY.LEAVE.fault: You signalled late or entered the exit slip too fast.
GB.MWY.LEAVE.why: Traffic behind needs early warning before you leave. Sharp bends on slip roads require a lower speed.
GB.MWY.LEAVE.tip: Signal left at the 300-yard marker and brake on the slip road.
GB.MWY.LEAVE.good: You signalled early and slowed smoothly on the slip road.

GB.MWY.SMART_TYPES.title: Know motorway lane types
GB.MWY.SMART_TYPES.fault: You misread the motorway lane layout.
GB.MWY.SMART_TYPES.why: Motorways use all-lane running, dynamic hard shoulders, or controlled lanes. Knowing each type helps you spot where to stop in a breakdown.
GB.MWY.SMART_TYPES.tip: Watch overhead gantries to see if the hard shoulder is open.
GB.MWY.SMART_TYPES.good: You read the motorway lane layout accurately.

GB.BRK.GO_LEFT.title: Go left, get safe
GB.BRK.GO_LEFT.fault: You did not follow motorway breakdown safety steps.
GB.BRK.GO_LEFT.why: In a breakdown, put hazards on and reach the left or an emergency area. Exit by the left door and wait behind the barrier.
GB.BRK.GO_LEFT.tip: If stuck in a live lane, keep seat belts on and call 999.
GB.BRK.GO_LEFT.good: You moved left, switched hazards on, and got safe.

GB.BRK.NO_TRIANGLE_MWY.title: No warning triangle on motorway
GB.BRK.NO_TRIANGLE_MWY.fault: You chose to place a triangle on a motorway.
GB.BRK.NO_TRIANGLE_MWY.why: Walking along a live motorway puts you at extreme risk. Never place a warning triangle on a motorway.
GB.BRK.NO_TRIANGLE_MWY.tip: Leave the car by the left door and get behind the barrier.
GB.BRK.NO_TRIANGLE_MWY.good: You stayed safely behind the barrier without walking on the road.

GB.BRK.REJOIN.title: Rejoin motorway safely
GB.BRK.REJOIN.fault: You rejoined without using the SOS phone or matching speed.
GB.BRK.REJOIN.why: From an emergency area, you must use the SOS phone so a lane can close. From a hard shoulder, build speed before merging.
GB.BRK.REJOIN.tip: Call via the orange SOS phone before leaving an emergency area.
GB.BRK.REJOIN.good: You followed the safe motorway rejoin steps.

GB.BRK.SAFE_PLACE.title: Pick a safe breakdown spot
GB.BRK.SAFE_PLACE.fault: You stopped in an unsafe place.
GB.BRK.SAFE_PLACE.why: Stopping on a bend or brow hides your car from traffic. Reach motorway services or an emergency area if you can.
GB.BRK.SAFE_PLACE.tip: Exit at the next services if your car starts losing power.
GB.BRK.SAFE_PLACE.good: You found a safe place off the main road.

GB.WRK.NO_LANE_JUMP.title: Stay in roadworks lanes
GB.WRK.NO_LANE_JUMP.fault: You jumped queues or drove into coned areas.
GB.WRK.NO_LANE_JUMP.why: Weaving in roadworks risks hitting workers or cones. Stay in your lane and keep a steady speed.
GB.WRK.NO_LANE_JUMP.tip: Hold your lane patiently through coned roadworks.
GB.WRK.NO_LANE_JUMP.good: You stayed smoothly in lane through the roadworks.

GB.WRK.MERGE_IN_TURN.title: Merge in turn
GB.WRK.MERGE_IN_TURN.fault: You blocked merging traffic or forced your way in.
GB.WRK.MERGE_IN_TURN.why: When lanes close at low speed, merging in turn keeps traffic moving. Take turns politely like a zip.
GB.WRK.MERGE_IN_TURN.tip: Use both lanes up to the merge point, then take turns.

GB.PRK.YELLOW_LINES.title: Obey yellow parking lines
GB.PRK.YELLOW_LINES.fault: You parked on restricted yellow lines.
GB.PRK.YELLOW_LINES.why: Double yellow lines mean no waiting at any time. Single yellow lines apply during the hours shown on nearby plates.
GB.PRK.YELLOW_LINES.tip: Always check kerb plates before parking near yellow lines.
GB.PRK.YELLOW_LINES.good: You parked only where waiting is permitted.

GB.PRK.CLEARWAY.title: No stopping on clearways
GB.PRK.CLEARWAY.why: Clearways keep fast main roads flowing without parked cars. You must not stop on the road.
GB.PRK.CLEARWAY.tip: Wait for a lay-by or side street before stopping.
GB.PRK.CLEARWAY.good: You kept the clearway completely clear.

GB.PRK.JUNCTION_10M.title: Park clear of junctions
GB.PRK.JUNCTION_10M.fault: You parked within 10 metres of a junction.
GB.PRK.JUNCTION_10M.why: Cars parked near corners block sightlines for emerging drivers and pedestrians. Leave at least 10 metres clear from any junction.
GB.PRK.JUNCTION_10M.tip: Park at least two car lengths away from every corner.
GB.PRK.JUNCTION_10M.good: You parked well clear of the junction.

GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.title: Use headlights at night
GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.fault: Your headlights were off on an unlit night road.
GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.why: Sidelights alone do not light hazards on dark roads. You must use dipped headlights at night on unlit roads.
GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.tip: Switch dipped headlights on whenever street lights end at night.
GB.WX.HEADLIGHTS_NIGHT.good: You used your headlights correctly at night.

GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.title: Dip headlights for others
GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.fault: You dazzled another driver with full beam.
GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.why: Full-beam headlights blind oncoming drivers and those ahead via their mirrors. You must dip your lights before dazzling anyone.
GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.tip: Dip to low beam as soon as you see headlights or tail lights.
GB.WX.NO_DAZZLE.good: You dipped your headlights promptly for other traffic.

GB.DRV.PHONE.title: Never use hand-held phone
GB.DRV.PHONE.fault: You picked up a hand-held phone while driving.
GB.DRV.PHONE.why: Checking a phone takes your eyes and mind off the road. You must never use a hand-held phone, even in traffic queues.
GB.DRV.PHONE.tip: Put your phone on silent and out of reach before driving.
GB.DRV.PHONE.good: You ignored the phone and stayed focused on the road.

GB.DRV.SEATBELT.title: Wear your seat belt
GB.DRV.SEATBELT.fault: You drove off without fastening your seat belt.
GB.DRV.SEATBELT.why: Seat belts prevent fatal injuries in sudden stops or crashes. You must wear one and ensure under-14 passengers do too.
GB.DRV.SEATBELT.tip: Buckle your seat belt before starting the engine.
GB.DRV.SEATBELT.good: You buckled up before pulling away.

GB.DRV.DRINK_DRUGS.title: Never drink or drug drive
GB.DRV.DRINK_DRUGS.fault: Alcohol and drugs impair safe driving.
GB.DRV.DRINK_DRUGS.why: Even small amounts slow your reaction time and judgement. You must never drive above the legal alcohol limit, which is lower in Scotland.
GB.DRV.DRINK_DRUGS.tip: Plan a safe ride home or choose zero-alcohol drinks.
GB.DRV.DRINK_DRUGS.good: You kept zero alcohol in your system before driving.

GB.GAP.WET_ICY.title: Double your gap in rain
GB.GAP.WET_ICY.fault: You followed too closely on a wet road.
GB.GAP.WET_ICY.why: Wet roads reduce tyre grip, so stopping distances are at least double.
GB.GAP.WET_ICY.tip: Leave at least a four-second gap behind the vehicle ahead in rain.
GB.GAP.WET_ICY.good: You kept a safe doubled gap on the wet road.

GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.title: Use headlights in low visibility
GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.fault: You drove in low visibility without headlights.
GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.why: You must use headlights when you cannot see more than 100 metres ahead.
GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.tip: Switch on dipped headlights as soon as fog or heavy spray reduces your view.
GB.WX.LOW_VISIBILITY.good: You switched on headlights promptly in poor visibility.

GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.title: Switch fog lights off
GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.fault: You left fog lights on in clear visibility.
GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.why: Fog lights dazzle other drivers and hide brake lights once visibility improves.
GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.tip: Turn front and rear fog lights off as soon as the fog clears.
GB.WX.FOG_LIGHTS.good: You used fog lights only while visibility stayed below 100 metres.

GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.title: Stop within your sight distance
GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.fault: You drove too fast for the fog ahead.
GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.why: In fog, always stop well within the distance you can see clearly.
GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.tip: Slow down in fog and do not chase the tail lights ahead.
GB.WX.FOG_STOPPING.good: You matched your speed safely to the distance you could see.
